info.description: Our very own OG Social Media.
info.title: Yorgut APIs

post.description: Validates the Google ID token from Sign in with Google, creates the user on their first login, and returns a Yorgut session token. Send it as "Authorization: Bearer <token>" on every other request.
post.summary: Logs in with a Google account.

post.description: Creates a community owned by the logged user, optionally with a picture (PNG or JPEG, max 5 MB and 50 megapixels; stored shrunk to 1024px and 1 MB).

parameters.description: Community category, one of transport.CommunityCategory (e.g. computers_internet)
parameters.name: category

parameters.description: Private: only members read the forum, and the owner accepts who joins
parameters.name: private

get.description: Returns a page of communities the logged user is not a member of, biggest first.
get.summary: Searches communities the logged user hasn't joined.

parameters.description: Part of the community name (omit to list all)
parameters.name: name

get.description: Returns the community matching the requested id
get.summary: Get Single community by id.

put.description: Replaces the community's name, category, description and privacy. Only the owner may (403 otherwise). Making a private community public accepts its pending join requests.

get.description: Returns a list of topics. In a private community, only members may read (403 otherwise).
get.summary: Gets the 5 newest topics of a community.

get.description: Returns a page of friends, most recently seen first, each saying whether they already are a member or already invited. Only members may (403 otherwise).
get.summary: Gets a page of the logged user's friends to invite to a community.

post.description: Only members may invite (403 otherwise), and only their friends (403). 409 when the friend is already a member or already invited.
post.summary: Invites a friend to join a community.

get.description: Returns the pending join requests, oldest first. Only the owner may (403 otherwise).
get.summary: Lists who asked to join a private community.

post.description: Accepting makes the user a member; declining drops the request. Only the owner may (403 otherwise).
post.summary: Accepts or declines a request to join a private community.

parameters.description: ID of the user who asked to join
parameters.name: userId

get.description: Returns a page of the community's members, most recently seen first
get.summary: Get a page of community members.

put.description: Uploads a PNG or JPEG (max 5 MB and 50 megapixels; stored shrunk to 1024px and 1 MB) as the community's picture. Only the owner may (403 otherwise).

get.description: Returns a page of polls, newest first. In a private community, only members may see them (403 otherwise).
get.summary: Gets a page of a community's polls.

post.description: Only members may (403 otherwise). Takes 2 to 10 different options; closesAt, when given, must be in the future.
post.summary: Creates a poll in a community.

get.description: Returns the community profile matching the requested id
get.summary: Get Single community profile by its id.

get.description: Returns 9 random communities other than this one, the same ones all day (communities don't record related ones yet)
get.summary: Get related communities.

get.description: Returns a page of topics, newest first. In a private community, only members may read (403 otherwise).
get.summary: Gets a page of a community's topics.

post.description: Logged user makes a new friendship request.

delete.summary: Deletes a Friendship by the target userId Id.

get.description: Public: how to reach the administrator. Fields the administrator didn't set are null.
get.summary: Gets this instance's public details.

get.description: Returns the user that owns the session token, with their settings
get.summary: Get the logged user.

put.description: Replaces the logged user's basic data and profile fields. Email can't be changed.

delete.description: Deletes the user and everything they wrote or did in the app. Each community they own goes to its longest-standing other member, or is deleted when nobody else is in it.
delete.summary: Deletes the logged user's account, for good.

get.description: Returns the friends whose birthday is in the next 30 days (today included), soonest first
get.summary: Gets the logged user's friends with a birthday in the next 30 days.

get.description: Returns the invitations friends sent the logged user to join their communities, newest first
get.summary: Gets the logged user's pending community invitations.

delete.description: Deletes the logged user's invitation (404 when there is none).
delete.summary: User declines an invitation to join a community.

post.description: Joins the community. In a private community, an invitation from a member other than the owner asks the owner instead, and answers pending true.
post.summary: User accepts an invitation to join a community.

get.description: Returns a page of friends, most recently seen first, each with the logged user's rating of them and whether they are a fan
get.summary: Gets a page of the logged user's friends, with their ratings and fan stars.

get.description: Returns a list of users
get.summary: Gets a list of friendship invites of the user.

get.description: Returns the friendship status between the logged user and userId. Answers 204 with no body when userId is the logged user.
get.summary: Evaluates if the logged user is friend of specified user

delete.description: Deletes the logged user's pending join request (404 when there is none).
delete.summary: User withdraws their request to join a private community.

post.description: Joins a public community. For a private one, asks the owner to accept the user and answers pending true.
Leaves a community. The owner can't leave (403).

get.description: Returns a page of communities
get.summary: Gets a page of the communities the logged user is a member of.

parameters.description: Shuffled instead of by name, the same way all day (for the profile box)
parameters.name: random

get.description: Says whether the logged user is a member, or is waiting for a private community's owner to accept them
get.summary: Evaluates if the logged user is member of specified community

get.description: Returns a page of communities, by name
get.summary: Gets a page of the communities the logged user created.

put.description: recordVisits false stops recording the user's visits to profiles and hides them from every visitor list (theirs too).
put.summary: Changes the logged user's privacy settings.

get.description: Returns the user matching the token
get.summary: Get logged user with it's profile by their Token.

put.description: Uploads a PNG or JPEG (max 5 MB and 50 megapixels; stored shrunk to 1024px and 1 MB) as the logged user's profile picture.
put.summary: Update the logged user's profile picture
Changes the look of the app for the logged user.

get.description: Returns the user stats
get.summary: Get user stats for the Home Welcome

post.description: Adds a PNG or JPEG (max 5 MB and 50 megapixels; stored shrunk to 1024px and 1 MB) to the logged user's personal album, which holds up to 12 photos (409 when full).
post.summary: Uploads a photo to the logged user's album.

get.description: Returns the album's photos (newest first), how many it holds and its limit.
get.summary: Lists the photos of a user's personal album.

delete.description: Removes one of the logged user's photos.
delete.summary: Deletes a photo from the logged user's album.

get.description: Each option's votes are null until the logged user voted or the poll closed. In a private community, only members may see it (403 otherwise).
get.summary: Gets a poll with its options.

post.description: Ends voting now. Only the poll's author or the community's owner may (403 otherwise); 409 when already closed.
Only members vote (403 otherwise), once (409 after that), while the poll is open (409 once closed).

get.description: Returns a page of the scraps sent to the user, newest first
get.summary: Gets a page of a user's scraps.

delete.description: Deletes the scrap for good. Only the owner of the scrapbook it is in and its author may (403 otherwise).

post.description: Logged user writes a testimonial for a friend. It stays pending until the recipient approves it.

get.description: Returns the approved testimonials of a user. When the logged user is the recipient, pending ones are included too.
get.summary: Gets the testimonials of a user.

parameters.description: Page of approved testimonials, starting at 1 (default 1)
parameters.name: page

delete.description: The recipient rejects or removes a testimonial, or the author deletes one they wrote.

post.description: The recipient approves a pending testimonial, making it public.
Creates a new Topic inside a community's forum. Only members of the community may post (403 otherwise).
Replies to an existing Topic inside a community's forum. Only members of the topic's community may reply (403 otherwise).

get.description: Returns the topic and a page of its replies, oldest first. In a private community, only members may read (403 otherwise).
get.summary: Gets a topic and a page of its replies

get.description: Returns a page of users
get.summary: Searches for a user by their name.

parameters.description: Part of the user's full name (omit to list all)
parameters.name: name

get.description: Returns the user matching the requested id
get.summary: Get Single user by id.

put.description: Logged user becomes a fan of a friend. Idempotent.
put.summary: Becomes a fan of a user.

delete.description: Logged user removes their star from a user. Idempotent.
delete.summary: Stops being a fan of a user.

get.description: Returns how many fans a user has, and whether the logged user is (or can become) one of them.
get.summary: Gets the fan summary of a user.

get.description: Returns a page of the users who are fans of the user, the newest first
get.summary: Gets a page of a user's fans.

get.description: Returns a page of friends, most recently seen first
get.summary: Gets a page of a user's friends.

get.description: Returns a page of communities
get.summary: Gets a page of the communities a user is a member of.

parameters.description: Shuffled instead of by name, the same way all day (for the profile box)
parameters.name: random

get.description: Returns the user matching the requested id, and counts a visit to their profile (see GET /me/welcome)
get.summary: Get Single user with it's profile by id.

put.description: Logged user creates or updates their review of a friend.

get.description: Returns the average cool, sexy and trustworthy ratings of a user, plus the logged user's own review.
get.summary: Gets the review summary of a user.

pending.description:
Pending is true when the logged user asked to join a private community
and the owner hasn't answered yet.

nextBirthday.description: NextBirthday is the date of the coming birthday (today counts).

pending.description: Pending is true when the logged user already asked to join.

closesAt.description:
ClosesAt is when voting ends; omitted, the poll stays open until its
author or the community's owner closes it.

theme.description: Theme is the look the user picked for the app.

canUpload.description: CanUpload is true when the logged user owns the album.

maxPhotos.description: MaxPhotos is how many photos the personal album can hold.

pending.description: Pending is only filled when the recipient is the one looking.

testimonials.description: Testimonials holds the approved testimonials, visible to everyone.

birthDate.description:
BirthDate is a calendar date; null when the viewer may not see it or
the user never set it.

hiddenFields.description:
HiddenFields are the profile fields left out for this viewer (by their
JSON names, "birthDate" included), so the page leaves their rows out
instead of showing "-".

visibility.description: Visibility tells which parts of the profile the viewer may see.

adminEmail.description:
AdminEmail is how to reach the administrator (ADMIN_EMAIL), null when
it isn't set.

member.description: Member: already in the community. Invited: someone already invited them.

userId.description: UserID is the friend being invited.

token.description: Token is the Yorgut session token, sent back as "Authorization: Bearer <token>".

credential.description: Credential is the Google ID token returned by Sign in with Google.

votes.description:
Votes is null until the logged user voted or the poll closed, so
results don't sway the vote.

canClose.description: CanClose: the author or the community's owner, while the poll is open.

canVote.description: CanVote: a member who hasn't voted, in an open poll.

myOptionId.description: MyOptionID is the logged user's vote, null when they haven't voted.

voted.description: Voted: the logged user voted in it.

accept.description: Accept false (or missing) declines the request.
Accept false (or missing) declines the request.

private.description: Making a private community public accepts its pending join requests.

birthDate.description: BirthDate is a calendar date, "YYYY-MM-DD"; empty keeps the current one.

hiddenProfileFields.description: Keys of the profile fields non-friends don't see; empty shows them all.

hasRatedFriends.description:
For the "próximas etapas": whether the user rated any current friend,
and how many communities they're in (DirectConnections is their friends).

recordVisits.description:
RecordVisits false: the user turned off "registrar minhas visitas", so
RecentVisitors is empty on purpose.

BearerAuth.description: Yorgut session token from POST /auth/google, sent as "Bearer <token>".
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
